id="notes" value="Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.<br>Chunk has one parent selected by strategy: section OR document. The two optional parent links are alternatives, not simultaneous parents.<br>Semantic tables use rowId PK and UNIQUE(id,indexAttemptId). Historical candidates can exist; retrieval serves accepted active rows.<br>Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.<br>Migrations declare partial uniqueness for active rows: at most one active ReelDocument per Reel, and one active section/chunk/scene per stable id. Live migration application is not probed." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#687782;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="1474.9840000000002" width="1399.032" height="137"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

div.div:
Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.
Chunk has one parent selected by strategy: section OR document. The two optional parent links are alternatives, not simultaneous parents.
Semantic tables use rowId PK and UNIQUE(id,indexAttemptId). Historical candidates can exist; retrieval serves accepted active rows.
Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.
Migrations declare partial uniqueness for active rows: at most one active ReelDocument per Reel, and one active section/chunk/scene per stable id. Live migration application is not probed.
